text:
maria: Heads-up: BluePeak asked us to run a joint perf/W + throughput smoke sweep on their edge kit (BP-EdgeX) next Wed. Want numbers for marketplace tile + a short joint blog. Can we scope quick?
kevin: good timing. what model set and sequence targets? also need to know whether we run stock kernel or partner-tuned kernel.
jihoon: propose: tiny-to-mid models: distil-gpt2, gpt-neo-1.3B, and a distilled Llama-2-7B. seq lengths: 256 and 1024 to reflect edge and server-ish. batch sizes: 1, 2, 4. concurrency 1,2,4. collect KV cache reuse.
maria: BluePeak wants the 1024 numbers highlighted for throughput/power efficiency. They asked for both "stock" and "tuned" kernel lines for transparency.
sara: product needs a single-page summary card + approved logo assets. embargo until coordinated pub. timeline?
devon: bench-bot here — created template job/bluepeak-watt-sweep-2024-04. Config brief: `models:[distilgpt2,gptneo-1.3b,llama2-7b-distill] seq:[256,1024] bs:[1,2,4] concurrency:[1,2,4] power_csv:/artifacts/power/$JOB_ID.csv`.
kevin: devon — add kernel toggle `kernel_variant=[stock,bluepeak-tuned]` and support `--collect-p99-per-token`.
devon: done. template accepts `kernel_variant` and will emit both A/B outputs to /artifacts/$JOB_ID/{stock,tuned}.
jihoon: Ensure we sample power at 50ms buckets for tail analysis, and capture PCIe CPU offload stats. snippet: `./run_sweep --model $M --seq $S --bs $B --kernel $K --power-sample-ms 50 --out /artifacts/$JOB_ID`.
alex: ops — BluePeak will only share anonymized power traces and IPMI. They require we do not post raw meter CSVs; aggregated charts OK. Legal? @legal please confirm embargo and data sharing constraints.
sara: I'll draft the marketplace blurb and embargo text. Can product get logo + partner quote by Tue EOD?
maria: partner confirmed assets by Tue. blockers: (1) partner signs bench addendum to MSA for kernel variant (2) legal signoff on embargo (3) infra creds for read-only artifact access.
kevin: infra plan: pre-signed S3 for aggregated charts + separate bucket for full artifacts accessible only to BluePeak and our legal/benching team. I can provision Wed AM.
jihoon: reproducibility: capture prompt seeds and dataset tarball (sha256) and include appendix. We'll also check retokenization parity.
devon: bench-bot: job/bluepeak-watt-sweep-2024-04 scheduled for 2024-04-10 09:00 UTC. Logs: /artifacts/bluepeak-watt-sweep-2024-04/logs. Artifacts will record `kernel_variant` in metadata.
maria: cool. tagging RED-612 for tracking. Follow-up sync Mon 09:30 to confirm legal + assets.
bench-bot: reminder set for Mon 09:15 UTC to collect pre-flight checklist.
